mcp_tool.description:
Remember a durable conclusion as compiled governed knowledge.

For distilled decisions, findings, failures, patterns, experiments and
production logs. Raw material goes to `capture_source`; proof-bearing
artifacts to `preserve_evidence`/`preserve_artifacts`.

Every non-empty source must already resolve to authorized governed Source
or Evidence material (a URL, remote file ID or derivative summary is not the
original): capture it first and cite its path or stable ref, else pass an
empty list. Unresolved citations return `UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_CITATION` and
write nothing. Details: references/writing.md.

Semantic authoring [exomem.semantic-authoring:v4 sha256:837b03b15c3d83f6c6eeb50771f4eaa04e4beaaae0f7d54be249be40ce7685f7]: Every new, replaced, or activated active compiled note needs at least one valid, non-empty semantic unit. Check new active creates, replacements, and inactive-to-active transitions; inactive drafts may remain unit-free until activation. A post-activation compliant page cannot lose its final valid semantic unit. Under `## Observations`, write `- [category] content #tags (context) ^anchor` with one primary open-vocabulary category; rich form is `## <Governed Kind>` with a substantive body. Choose exactly one primary category: prefer a meaningful epistemic or operational role and put the domain in tags, but if the role would only be a generic fact, finding, or observation and the domain is the durable lens, use a domain category instead. Role example: - [decision] Relocate to a coastal city next spring #life ^relocation `missing_semantic_unit`: Add `## Observations` and `- [operating constraint] Keep retries bounded #reliability`. Alternatively add `## Decision`, a blank line, and a substantive body. Core keys, aliases and the rich example: call bootstrap(profile="full").

mcp_tool.description:
Edit an existing memory page with an auditable reason.

For small corrections, section, batch string or opinion-row edits, or one
frontmatter field; substantial rewrites go to `replace_memory`.

A source-changing edit validates the full final `sources` list against
authorized governed Source or Evidence material; unrelated edits leave a
legacy unresolved citation alone.

`RELATION_DISPOSITION_STALE`/`_MISSING`: repeat the identical operation with
`validate_only=true`, then commit unchanged with
`transition_token=<returned transition_token>`,
`relation_disposition="reviewed_none"`,
`relation_review_hash=<returned relation_review_hash>` (not the page
content hash) and a `relation_review_reason`. Or author a relation in the body:
`## Relations` then `- supports [[Knowledge Base/Notes/Research/example-target]]`;
Dataview `supports:: [[...]]` is not supported relation syntax.
See references/writing.md.

mcp_tool.description:
Run a governed, resumable Adoption Studio session over existing material.

Never rewrites, moves or deletes originals. `plan` previews the exact
imports and `apply` commits exactly that plan or refuses. `status` is the
read-only default; `start` is guarded.

Lifecycle: `start` scans read-only; `select` picks files by folder rule;
`plan` previews; `apply` copies the subset into Sources in one atomic batch;
`cancel` closes a pre-apply run; `finish` proves recall. Afterwards
`work-item` reads bounded context, `propose` submits proposals,

mcp_tool.description:
Manage files through one governed file operation.

Tier-2 escape hatch for structures typed memory commands do not fit.
Destructive operations need the same explicit flags as their canonical
leaves. validate_only and review fields apply only to Markdown create/append.

Semantic authoring [exomem.semantic-authoring:v4 sha256:837b03b15c3d83f6c6eeb50771f4eaa04e4beaaae0f7d54be249be40ce7685f7]: manage_memory_file create, overwrite, and append receive the same semantic precommit contract on the complete resulting compiled Markdown; prefer remember or replace_memory when their typed route fits. Every new, replaced, or activated active compiled note needs at least one valid, non-empty semantic unit. Check new active creates, replacements, and inactive-to-active transitions; inactive drafts may remain unit-free until activation. A post-activation compliant page cannot lose its final valid semantic unit. Under `## Observations`, write `- [category] content #tags (context) ^anchor` with one primary open-vocabulary category; rich form is `## <Governed Kind>` with a substantive body. `missing_semantic_unit`: Add `## Observations` and `- [operating constraint] Keep retries bounded #reliability`. Alternatively add `## Decision`, a blank line, and a substantive body. Core keys, aliases and the rich example: call bootstrap(profile="full").
